hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *sample-app/*|*.github/workflows/*) case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0 ;; *) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"sample-app/ and CI config changes must happen inside a topic worktree (.claude/worktrees/<topic-slug>). Run /investigate or /cycle for this topic instead of editing directly (CLAUDE.md rule 6/7).\"}}"; exit 0 ;; esac ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) exit 0 ;; *) staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(sample-app/|\.github/workflows/)' || true); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Staged changes include sample-app/ or CI files but this is not a topic worktree. Implementation commits must happen inside .claude/worktrees/<topic-slug> (CLAUDE.md rule 6/7).\"}}"; fi ;; esac ;; esac
